But this card, combined with the new Starting Interrupt Start Your Engines, makes podracing a nice side theme for almost any deck. Once the race is begun, both players compete, even if they don't have a podracer at the arena – though having one certainly ups your chances. Why wouldn't you start the race with the first turn?
